title.en: An Act Granting to Consuelo D. Borja a Franchise to Install, Operate, and Maintain An Electric Light, Heat, and Power Plant in the Municipality of Iligan, Province of Lanao, Philippine Islands.

text.en:
Subject to the rules and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and
thirty-six, there is hereby granted to Consuelo D. Borja, for a period of fifty years from the approval of this
Act, the right, privilege and authority to construct, maintain and operate an electric light, heat and power
system for the purpose of generating and distributing electric light, heat and power, for sale within the limits
of the municipality of Iligan, Province of Lanao, Philippine Islands.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 6, 1930.
